fasterCampaigns.title: 30x Faster Campaign Creation
fasterCampaigns.description: Traditional campaign setup takes 30+ minutes. Reeply AI does it all automatically in seconds.

testimonial1.quote: We now generate 80% of our leads through campaigns managed with Reeply AI. Thanks to the consistently excellent support, we look forward to planning and executing more projects with Max and Reeply AI in the future.
testimonial1.name: Christian Schmitt
testimonial1.title: Business owner at Boldbrands

websiteAnalysis.title: Smart Website Analysis
websiteAnalysis.description: Reeply AI scans your website URL to understand your business, audience, and products—automatically selecting the perfect campaign type for your goals.

adCopy.title: AI-Generated Ad Copy
adCopy.description: Based on your company description, our AI writes compelling ad text that resonates with your audience and highlights your unique value proposition.

geoTargeting.title: Intelligent Geo-Targeting
geoTargeting.description: Reeply AI determines optimal geolocation targeting from your website and profile preferences, ensuring your ads reach the right audience in the right locations.

audienceTargeting.title: Advanced Audience Targeting
audienceTargeting.description: Our AI agent researches the best potential filters on Meta Ads to target your ideal audience, finding hidden opportunities other marketers might miss.

localAdvertising.title: Targeted Local Advertising
localAdvertising.description: By setting your preferred locations, you help our AI target your campaigns more effectively to the regions that matter most to your business.

locationBenefits.title: Benefits of Location Targeting
locationBenefits.benefit1: Higher conversion rates from local audiences
locationBenefits.benefit2: Reduced ad spend wastage on irrelevant regions
locationBenefits.benefit3: More relevant messaging for specific geographic areas

facebookIntegration.title: Seamless Facebook Integration
facebookIntegration.description: Connect your Facebook account to unlock the full potential of Reeply AI. Create and manage campaigns directly without switching between platforms.

whyConnect.title: Why Connect with Facebook?
whyConnect.benefit2: Access detailed analytics and performance metrics
whyConnect.benefit3: Auto-optimize campaigns based on real-time data
whyConnect.benefit4: Manage leads directly from within Reeply AI

profileReady.title: Your Profile is Ready!
profileReady.description: You're all set to create your first AI-powered campaign in 60 seconds.

testimonial2.quote: I loved working with the Reeply team - dedicated, patient, professional. They are experienced and were able to jump in to problem solve, no matter how big or small the problem. I enjoyed using the Reeply platform to help me get started on my Meta ads journey. It's simple and easy to use. They helped me to launch my very first lead generation, awareness, and conversion ads. It was easy to see all my campaign results in one handy interface. I managed to gain half a million views on one of my videos in just a few days. I also gained a lot of insights on what kind of ads worked, and what didn't work. Thank you Reeply.
testimonial2.name: Lin Loke
testimonial2.title: Founder of Nuwa Wellness
